note: Ranked MCM binding sites, GSE242131. The rank cut comes from the ARS-negative fragments (docs/tier-rebuild.md). The window is NOT this assay’s measured p75 of 130 bp: that was measured against curated confirmed-origin intervals, and the sites tested here include v2 records whose coordinates are less precise, so 500 bp is a deliberate tolerance.
Okazaki-fragment initiation zones, GSE40696, re-analysed. Window is the measured p75 positional error.

MCM2-7 double-hexamer footprints in G1 - the loaded helicase, which is what licensing means. Reuter also reports ORC footprints; ORC binding without MCM2-7 is not licensing and does not count here. This table is indexed on the OriDB origin list (295 of its 308 calls sit at a Confirmed origin), so it can rarely promote a site on its own; it is kept because where it does fall on a non-Confirmed site that is real, independent evidence.

ORC footprints Reuter annotates as NON-origin sites: ORC is bound and MCM2-7 is not loaded. Recorded so that the matrix shows these sites were examined, and explicitly excluded from the tier - an annotated non-origin cannot be evidence for an origin. It supported 35 Likely and 30 Unsupported sites while it counted.
Replication timing. Recorded in the matrix but excluded from the tier: a timing peak locates replication, not initiation, and its p90 measures detection rather than position.
